in_marathi.name: Pranavraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Vibration of Prana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pranavraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pranavraj is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pranava' which means 'the vibration of Prana or life force'. In Hindu mythology, Pranav is considered the syllable 'Om', which represents the ultimate reality and the cosmic sound. The name Pranavraj is believed to bring blessings of wisdom, spiritual growth, and good fortune.
